proposed_fixture_sources.content: The Orbit API uses REST endpoints under the /api/v2 prefix.
The production web frontend is deployed to Vercel.
The primary application database is PostgreSQL.
Background jobs use a Redis-backed worker queue.
The API rate limit is 120 requests per minute per user.
The maximum supported upload size is 25 MB per file.
Uploaded documents are indexed asynchronously after upload.
Document embeddings are stored in pgvector.
API timestamps are normalized to UTC.
This release supports English-language document retrieval only.
The public status page is hosted separately from the application API.
API error responses include a request_id field.
Web sessions expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
Workspace owners must use multi-factor authentication.
Service-account credentials must be rotated every 90 days.
Production customer data must not be copied into development workspaces.
Audit logs are retained for 180 days.
Private team chat requires workspace membership.
Confidential exported reports must be encrypted at rest.
API keys must never be committed to source control.
Workspace administrator access reviews occur quarterly.
Confirmed security incidents must be reported within 30 minutes.
Backups are encrypted before transfer to off-site storage.
New service accounts use least-privilege access by default.
Sprint 15 runs from 2 November through 13 November 2026.
The release candidate is planned for 11 November 2026.
The target production launch date is 16 November 2026.
The release requires zero open P0 or P1 defects.
Priya owns the document export feature.
Omar owns the workspace search improvement.
Lin owns the mobile layout fixes.
Feature scope freezes at 5 PM UTC on 10 November 2026.
The release retrospective is scheduled for 18 November 2026.
A successful database migration rehearsal is required before release.
The rollout plan uses a 10 percent canary before full production rollout.
The release manager owns the rollback decision.
Task T01: Document export. Owner: Priya. Status: in_progress. Due: 7 November 2026. Add CSV and PDF export for saved workspace reports.
Task T02: Search relevance tuning. Owner: Omar. Status: todo. Due: 9 November 2026. Tune ranking for exact title matches.
Task T03: Mobile navigation fixes. Owner: Lin. Status: in_progress. Due: 6 November 2026. Fix collapsed navigation on small screens.
Task T04: Migration rehearsal. Owner: Mateo. Status: todo. Due: 10 November 2026. Run a staging rehearsal of the production database migration.
Task T05: P0/P1 defect triage. Owner: Nina. Status: in_progress. Due: daily. Review all open P0 and P1 defects before release.
Task T06: Canary rollout checklist. Owner: Mateo. Status: todo. Due: 12 November 2026. Prepare the 10 percent canary rollout checklist.
Task T07: Audit log export review. Owner: Priya. Status: todo. Due: 11 November 2026. Verify encryption requirements for exported audit logs.
Task T08: Service account rotation. Owner: Omar. Status: todo. Due: 13 November 2026. Rotate the integration service account credentials.
Task T09: Status page separation check. Owner: Lin. Status: done. Due: 5 November 2026. Confirm the status page remains separate from the API.
Task T10: English retrieval test. Owner: Nina. Status: done. Due: 5 November 2026. Verify English-only retrieval behavior.
Task T11: Request ID error test. Owner: Mateo. Status: in_progress. Due: 8 November 2026. Check request_id in API error responses.
Task T12: Session expiry regression test. Owner: Nina. Status: todo. Due: 9 November 2026. Test session expiration after inactivity.
Task T13: Quarterly access review. Owner: Omar. Status: todo. Due: 30 November 2026. Collect workspace administrator access review evidence.
Task T14: Incident reporting drill. Owner: Priya. Status: todo. Due: 12 November 2026. Rehearse the security reporting process.
Task T15: Backup restore check. Owner: Mateo. Status: in_progress. Due: 11 November 2026. Verify encrypted off-site backup restoration.
Task T16: Embedding pipeline monitor. Owner: Lin. Status: done. Due: 4 November 2026. Confirm document indexing completes asynchronously.
Priya: The export task is in progress; I expect to finish the first pass by 7 November.
Omar: Search relevance tuning is blocked until the exact-title test cases are merged.
Lin: The mobile navigation fix passed on a narrow viewport, but tablet verification remains.
Mateo: I will run the migration rehearsal on 10 November, provided staging data refresh finishes first.
Nina: We currently have one P1 defect open, so the release gate is not satisfied yet.
Mateo: Keep the canary at 10 percent until the release manager reviews the dashboard.
Priya: I will check confidential audit exports are encrypted before marking the review complete.
Omar: The integration service-account rotation is planned for 13 November.
Lin: I confirmed the public status page is hosted separately from the API.
Nina: The retrieval test only covers English documents for this release.
Mateo: The error response test should verify request_id on failed API requests.
Nina: I added a regression case for the 15-minute idle session expiry.
Omar: Administrator access review evidence should be ready by the end of November.
Priya: The incident drill should use the policy's 30-minute reporting requirement.
Mateo: The restore check will verify backups are encrypted before off-site transfer.
Lin: The embedding monitor confirms indexing is asynchronous; I will watch failed jobs.
